Transfer Fee.name: Transfer Fee
Transfer Fee.comment: Documentation Fee (R136 business name; the column keeps its name): a one-off fee added to the first-day charge interest of a daily-interest or daily-instalment loan and netted off at disbursement, so it is profit on the loan date. A fixed-due-date loan has no first-day charge.

Interest Schedule Anchor Date.name: Interest Schedule Anchor Date
Interest Schedule Anchor Date.comment: Optional daily-interest schedule origin. First subsequent scheduled charge is anchor plus Interest Payment Interval. NULL uses Loan Date. Does not reset interest accrual or change existing charges.

Ref Closing Payment.name: Ref Closing Payment
Ref Closing Payment.comment: Payment that changed this loan from open to closed. SQL-owned; NULL for pre-migration or non-payment closure. No historical inference/backfill.

Charge Generation Request.name: Charge Generation Request
Charge Generation Request.comment: Manual generation command: Bangkok YYYY-MM-DD|unique token. Hidden and user-read-only in AppSheet; SQL derives charge components. Latest command only, not a financial ledger.

Original Daily Interest Rate.name: Original Daily Interest Rate
Original Daily Interest Rate.comment: Original average daily interest / original principal * 100, rounded to integer percentage points (1 means 1%). Frozen at creation. NULL means original terms unavailable.

Ref Rollover Source Loan.name: Ref Rollover Source Loan
Ref Rollover Source Loan.comment: R136: the original loan this loan was created from by a rollover (loan.rollover), which closed it with a net-off settlement on the rollover day. Set only by pwa_apply_loan_rollover_v1; null on every other loan.

pwa_versioned_envelope.name: pwa_versioned_envelope
pwa_versioned_envelope.definition:
CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(canonical_json::jsonb) = 'object'::text AND (canonical_json::jsonb ->> 'contractVersion'::text) = contract_version::text AND
CASE
    WHEN contract_version = 1 THEN canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,requestId}'::text[]
    ELSE canonical_json::jsonb ->> 'requestId'::text
END = request_id::text AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,issuer}'::text[]) = actor_issuer AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,subject}'::text[]) = actor_subject AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,partnerId}'::text[]) = actor_partner_id AND (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{actor,loginEmail}'::text[]) = actor_login_email) IS TRUE)

pwa_versioned_outcome.name: pwa_versioned_outcome
pwa_versioned_outcome.definition: CHECK ((contract_version = 1 AND result_json IS NULL AND (outcome = 'posted'::text AND payment_id = ('pwa:'::text || request_id::text) AND rejection_code IS NULL OR outcome = 'rejected'::text AND payment_id IS NULL AND (rejection_code = ANY (ARRAY['invalid_date'::text, 'borrower_unavailable'::text, 'account_unavailable'::text, 'selection_unavailable'::text]))) OR contract_version = 2 AND payment_id IS NULL AND (outcome = 'applied'::text AND rejection_code IS NULL AND jsonb_typeof(result_json) = 'object'::text AND octet_length(result_json::text) <= 524288 AND result_json ?& ARRAY['operation'::text, 'targetType'::text, 'targetId'::text, 'paymentId'::text, 'plan'::text, 'predecessorRequestId'::text] AND (result_json - ARRAY['operation'::text, 'targetType'::text, 'targetId'::text, 'paymentId'::text, 'plan'::text, 'predecessorRequestId'::text, 'sourceCreatedBy'::text, 'rebate'::text, 'settlement'::text, 'rollover'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND (NOT (result_json ? 'settlement'::text OR result_json ? 'rollover'::text) OR (result_json ->> 'operation'::text) = 'loan.rollover'::text AND jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'settlement'::text) = 'object'::text AND jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'rollover'::text) = 'object'::text) AND (NOT result_json ? 'rebate'::text OR (result_json ->> 'operation'::text) = 'loan.close'::text AND jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'rebate'::text) = 'object'::text) AND (NOT result_json ? 'sourceCreatedBy'::text OR (jsonb_typeof(result_json -> 'sourceCreatedBy'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['string'::text, 'null'::text]))) AND (result_json ->> 'operation'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,operation}'::text[]) AND (result_json ->> 'targetType'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,targetType}'::text[]) AND (result_json ->> 'targetId'::text) = (canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{command,targetId}'::text[]) OR outcome = 'rejected'::text AND result_json IS NULL AND (rejection_code = ANY (ARRAY['source_conflict'::text, 'not_found'::text, 'invalid_reference'::text, 'borrower_name_exists'::text, 'dependency_conflict'::text, 'insufficient_funds'::text, 'plan_changed'::text, 'invalid_date'::text, 'account_unavailable'::text, 'record_requires_reconciliation'::text, 'rollover_ineligible'::text])))) IS TRUE)

definition.name: first_day_charge_trigger
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.first_day_charge_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT starts_with(NEW."Row ID",'lc7:') AND NOT starts_with(NEW."Row ID",'df10:') AND NOT starts_with(NEW."Row ID",'rl138:') /* R136 */ THEN
    PERFORM public.first_day_receipt(NEW."Row ID");
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
